# Analysis

> a department of the lab — received, run within the sample's stability, result released

**Types:** `Analysis`, `AnalysisTask`, `AnalysisHandling` (package Analysis)

**Commands in:** Analysed, DeviationPending, DeviationResolved, Expect, Haemolysed, Missing, Plan, Queued, Received, Rejected, Released, SampleStopped, SiteDescribed

**Events out:** AnalysisMisplanned, AnalysisPlanned, SampleStopped, StabilityExpired

**Policies reacting:** ask_analysis_site (on AnalysisPlanned); sample_stopped (on SampleStopped)

[All topics](index.md)

## Rules

<a id="R10"></a>
### R10 — Stability counts from when the run is expected

`agreed` · behavioural · decided in session 2, 2026-03-09, answering [Q-2](questions.md#Q-2) · supersedes [R11](analysis.md#R11)

**release:** 1

A sample must reach the analyser within its stability, counted from when its run is expected. Queued on the analyser it is kept cool and no longer ages. After a deviation is resolved, it ages again from then. Too old, the run fails and the sample stops.

- **Model:** `AnalysisHandling.open on Expect`, `AnalysisHandling.open.expected.ageing after stability`, `AnalysisHandling.open.on_hold on DeviationResolved`
- **Shown by:** 04-stability-expired

<a id="R11"></a>
### R11 — ~~Stability counts from collection~~

`superseded` · behavioural · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02, answering [Q-2](questions.md#Q-2)

A sample's stability is counted from when it was collected.

- **Since:** superseded by [R10](analysis.md#R10)

<a id="R12"></a>
### R12 — How a released result reaches the doctor

`deferred` · behavioural · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02

**release:** 2

The report task ends at Released. Sending the result to the doctor's system is left out until the lab's interface is chosen.

<a id="R17"></a>
### R17 — An analysis runs at a lab; planned at a clinic, the planner is told

`agreed` · behavioural · decided in session 3, 2026-03-16, answering [Q-3](questions.md#Q-3)

A site is a clinic or a lab, registered once. A step names its site by the id alone, so an analysis asks its site what it is. Only a lab runs an analysis: one planned at a clinic is flagged to the planner at once, before any sample arrives.

- **Model:** `Site`, `Analysis.created on SiteDescribed#clinic`, `Analysis.in_progress on SiteDescribed#clinic`, `ask_analysis_site`
- **Shown by:** 11-an-analysis-planned-at-a-clinic
